answer: A Dedicated device bound by in-person pickup code with revocation on transfer turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A jade out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. From the nadir to the pulse, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
